bayts.text: Seven (verses of the Fātiḥa) protect from the gates of every fire, and bestow the dirham and the dīnār.
They benefit whoever has pondered them, with the two treasures of the two Abodes, wherever he took heed.
They close the gates of Hell, seven, to whoever has pondered (them), and make his benefit grow.
They lead every beneficial wish to whoever teaches and seeks to profit.
They drive the Accursed away from their reciter, through the repelling of a Guide Who never ceases to help.
They bestow sciences and deeds, leading to the request and the hopes.
They help the reciter in his needs, and save the children as well as the wives.
They ward off enemies, hunger and plague, as they soften whoever has stubbornly refused.
They increase intellect and repel harm from whoever keeps to them, and ward off peril.
They make the difficult easy and multiply the reward in every permitted thing, and guide to what is right.
They lead to good whoever keeps to them, as they save from all harm.
They open the gates of the Gardens, honour the side of whoever reads them, and he is honoured.
They bestow healing from every illness, as they bestow the aim upon the reciter.
They repel the plot of the plotters, and make their reciter grow with the best reward and spoil.
They multiply the goods of the dwellings, and bring down whoever sought to wrong the party of the One.
They lead whoever reads them to his wish, and toward the heights they bring him out of doubt.
They bridle the mouths of the corrupters, and preserve the merchandise from slump.
They illumine the heart of every righteous one, and grant him reward together with righteousness.
Whoever recites them for a need, it is met without doubt; and whoever does not recite them shall never be accepted.
And whoever has recited them sincerely for the Countenance of Him Who sent them down has won reward and safety.
And whoever has entered into an affair with them shall not be disappointed nor brought low.
And whoever sought something precious with them obtained it from a Liberator Who made His beauty perpetual for me.
And whoever has recited them in following (the Prophet) is rewarded with a Generous, Liberating One, Who has not been restrained.
And whoever has recited them, being God-fearing, has attained the good pleasure of Him Who bestowed permanence.
May He bless and grant peace to Muḥammad, his Family, his Companions and the praisers,
(He) Who placed the Qurʾān, when He sent it down from His Tablet, in the hand of the Spirit (Gabriel), and it descended.
May the Beautiful bless them both and grant them peace, and He has been for me with His grace wherever I turn.
May He bless them both, with the Family of the Chosen, his Companions and all who attained election.
May the Best Appreciative, the Raiser, the All-Hearing bless and grant peace to all.
And the most excellent blessing with the best peace upon them both, as (He) has benefited by the Word.
